sources: https://www.roverpass.com/c/cedar-ridge-rv-park-storage-bakersfield-mo/booking/ (RoverPass booking API: park record, rates for 2027-06-19 and 2027-06-22, carts)

values.note: Posted: daily $30; weekly $169 (30 amp) / $189 (50 amp); monthly $375 (30 amp) / $475 (50 amp). On RoverPass every full-hookup type was $30 a night (Tue 2027-06-22 and Sat 2027-06-19) except the 50-amp pull-through at $35 on the Saturday; RoverPass adds its own platform and processing fees.

fees.source: https://www.rvparkcedarridge.com/about ('CAMPING RATES', 'Daily $30', 'Weekly $169 (30 amp)/$189 (50 amp)', 'Monthly $375(30 amp)/$475(50 amp)') + RoverPass booking API (rates 'Full Hookups 30/50 Amps - Back In/Pull Through' $30.00, 50A pull-through $35.00 on 2027-06-19), read 2026-11-08

hookups.source: https://www.rvparkcedarridge.com/ ('Water, electric, and sewer available') + RoverPass site records (amps_20/30/50, water_hookups, sewer_hookups on sites 6, 8, 9, 17, 18), read 2026-11-08

sites.source: https://www.rvparkcedarridge.com/ ('Sites measure 30 ft. wide by 60 ft. long. Pull-through and back-in sites') + RoverPass site records (maxLength 60, pull_through on 8 and 9), read 2026-11-08

facilities.source: https://www.rvparkcedarridge.com/ ('Laundromat-Open to campers and the general public'), read 2026-11-08

values.note: The operator prefers reservations by phone at 417-257-0965 ('To eliminate double bookings ... we prefer to guarantee reservations by telephone'). The RoverPass page answers 'Campground is closed' from Aug 14 to Jun 15 each year, so online booking is a summer-only option; walk in to the office to check in (same-day arrivals after hours check in next morning).

booking.source: https://www.rvparkcedarridge.com/contact + RoverPass booking API (closeSeasonDates 2026-08-14..2027-06-15, 2027-08-14..2028-06-15; checkInProcedure), read 2026-11-08

note: Hilltop park on the edge of Bakersfield, minutes from Norfork Lake, with open-sky views of the surrounding ridges and sunsets; boat/RV storage and 48 self-storage units share the property. --Claude
summary: Operator site + RoverPass: $30 daily (weekly/monthly posted), RoverPass $30-35; full hookups 50A, sites 30x60 ft, pull-throughs, laundromat; RoverPass booking (online only mid-Jun to mid-Aug; phone preferred). Count (35, from old note) not stated by the operator, left. 'Dry sites' and 'walking trails' from the old note are not on the operator's pages (dropped).
flags: Gate facts: posted daily rate $30 (RoverPass $30-35), passes; presence = working website with phone 417-257-0965 plus a bookable RoverPass listing (claimed, isBookable). Google Maps 4.6 over 9 reviews (under 25); RV Life 2* over 2 reviews (under 25, nothing triggers). Reviews read are transient stays ('We had a 32' class C motorhome ... plenty of room', 'Brought the big Motorhome in, no problem', 'Only one in the area open "out of season"').

Long-stay/storage character: weekly and monthly rates are posted and the name carries '& Storage', but a daily rate is posted and RoverPass offered 5 open RV sites for one night in June 2027, so tests 2 and 4 pass; not read as long-stay in character.
Phone missing: operator's number is 417-257-0965 (alt 417-284-1970), on every page of rvparkcedarridge.com and the RoverPass record.

Season unknown: RoverPass blocks Aug 14 - Jun 15 as 'Campground is closed', but a 2-years-ago review says it was 'the only one in the area open out of season'; the operator's site states no season, so season is left unset.
